_style: cute fantasy creature foley, close-mic, punchy, no music, no voices

boing.prompt: big soft jelly blob hopping off the floor, rubbery boing with a wet squish

splat.prompt: heavy wet jelly body slapping onto a stone floor and spreading out, thick wet splat

slice.prompt: steel sword swinging fast and cutting cleanly through thick jelly, swish then a wet slice

gulp.prompt: huge slimy blob swallowing something whole, deep wet gulp

jelly.prompt: big jelly wobbling after being poked, short wet wobble

squelch.prompt: thick slime squelching and stretching, gooey wet squelch

wobble.prompt: water balloon jiggling and sloshing, rubbery wobble fading out

sizzle.prompt: acid bubbling and fizzing on a body, hissing sizzle

drip.prompt: single water drop falling into a puddle in a damp cave, clear plink with a little echo

pour.prompt: thick liquid slime pouring and sliding under a wooden door, slow wet slither

steam.prompt: water evaporating in hot sun, soft rising hiss of steam

bubble.prompt: slow thick bubbles rising and popping in goo, a few wet blorps

pop.prompt: single soft wet bubble pop, short and bright

whoosh_big.prompt: big soft jelly blob lunging fast through the air, heavy whoosh

heartbeat.prompt: slow deep heartbeat, soft lub-dub thump

sparkle.prompt: tiny glittering magical twinkle, gentle chime shimmer
